title: Sanity testing: did that specific fix work?

videos.script: Rui says he has fixed two defects. {{claim}} Six tickets are accepted now, and a member who books five gets fifteen percent off, not twenty-five. {{fixes}} Before anybody spends a day on this build, one question comes first. Did those two fixes actually work? {{question}} That is a sanity check, and it is narrow on purpose. It looks at the change and at what sits right beside it. Nothing else. {{narrow}} It is not the smoke test of lesson 8. Smoke asks whether the build comes up at all. Sanity asks whether this one change did what it claimed. {{smoke}} In this lesson you make release 1.1 yourself, with three edits to boxoffice. {{edits}} Then you check it. The version first, then six tickets and seven, then two discounts. {{checks}} It takes a few minutes. And by the end you will know what a passed sanity check tells you, and what it leaves unsaid. {{limits}}
